'''Akiko Hiramatsu''' (Japanese: '''平松晶子''' ''Hiramatsu Akiko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Hiramatsu was born on August 31, 1967 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. Hiramatsu did minor work for {{aniseries|PTS}}, voicing [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] as well as {{pkmn|movie}} characters. Her most famous role was providing the voice of [[Jessie]] when her usual voice actress, [[Megumi Hayashibara]], went on maternity leave. She is currently working for Ken Production, a Japanese voice actor management agency.
